results.concept: Error 404: Sleep Not Found - minimalist design for developers

prompt_data.main_prompt: Create a minimalist T-shirt design for the 'Error 404: Sleep Not Found' concept featuring a sleek tech aesthetic and clean typography. The design should include modern geometric elements in a monochromatic color palette with accent colors. Focus on a simple yet eye-catching composition that would be perfect for print-on-demand production.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid overly complex designs, low-quality graphics, and poorly executed typography. Ensure the final product is visually appealing and suitable for printing on high-quality T-shirt material.

results.concept: Level Up Your Style - retro gaming inspired design

prompt_data.main_prompt: Create a retro gaming inspired T-shirt design featuring nostalgic gaming culture with pixel art elements for DreamShaperXL Turbo. Incorporate vibrant neon colors with dark backgrounds, 8-bit style, and synthwave influences. Use pixelated graphics and retro typography to depict a 'Level Up Your Style' theme, suitable for print-on-demand production.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid low-quality designs, poor color choices, and overcrowded compositions. Ensure proper legibility of typography on dark backgrounds.

results.concept: Fresh Threads - bold urban streetwear design

prompt_data.main_prompt: Design a bold and contemporary urban streetwear T-shirt featuring eye-catching graffiti-inspired graphics. Use high contrast colors with bold accent hues such as electric blue, hot pink, or neon green. Include a clear, legible typography for the logo and make sure the design is suitable for print-on-demand production.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid low-quality designs, poorly chosen color combinations, unclear or illegible typography, and overly complex compositions. Keep the focus on urban streetwear aesthetics with bold graphics.
